brief: 5 data tools that turn raw events into shipped product insights.

slots.eyebrow: from raw events to shipped insights
slots.desc1: Collect clean events from every app and website.
slots.desc2: Scale warehouse compute without touching servers.
slots.desc3: Transform messy tables into production-grade models.
slots.desc4: Turn behavioral signals into retention experiments.
slots.desc5: Share living notebooks that sync to your warehouse.

slots.toolTagline: The customer data platform that collects once, syncs everywhere.
slots.bigStatement: Stop rebuilding tracking plans. One schema feeds your entire data stack.
slots.use1Body: Capture clicks, signups, and revenue in real time.
slots.use2Body: Enforce naming conventions before bad data spreads.
slots.use3Body: Send clean payloads to Snowflake without engineering.

slots.toolTagline: The elastic cloud warehouse built for zero infrastructure overhead.
slots.bigStatement: Store petabytes of events and pay only for the queries you run.
slots.use1Body: Ingest billions of rows without provisioning servers.
slots.use2Body: Let analysts query without blocking production pipelines.
slots.use3Body: Share live tables across business units securely.

slots.toolTagline: The transformation layer that brings software rigor to SQL.
slots.bigStatement: Replace fragile scripts with version-controlled models tested in CI.
slots.use1Body: Git-track every model, test, and documentation change.
slots.use2Body: Catch schema drift and null duplicates before deploy.
slots.use3Body: Auto-build a data dictionary from your model code.

slots.toolTagline: The product intelligence platform that reveals why users stay or leave.
slots.bigStatement: Move beyond vanity metrics and ship experiments backed by behavior.
slots.use1Body: Find the exact step where onboarding drops off.
slots.use2Body: Compare how features impact 7-day and 30-day stickiness.
slots.use3Body: Push winning variants back into your release cycle.

slots.toolTagline: The collaborative notebook where SQL, Python, and charts live together.
slots.bigStatement: Turn warehouse queries into interactive stories the whole team trusts.
slots.use1Body: Query Snowflake directly and visualize in one canvas.
slots.use2Body: Publish dashboards that refresh as the warehouse updates.
slots.use3Body: Comment, fork, and iterate with stakeholders in-app.

slots.toolTagline: The reverse ETL platform that syncs warehouse data to your product.
slots.bigStatement: Close the loop by activating models inside the tools teams use daily.
slots.use1Body: Sync SQL audiences to Salesforce, Braze, or Slack.
slots.use2Body: Trigger in-app prompts from warehouse feature flags.
slots.use3Body: Feed product insights back into customer success workflows.

slots.body: Build a pipeline that turns raw behavior into product decisions. No guesswork, just clean data.
